selectionNote: Selected 12 guided Bali d98/d5467/d22287 products with live public USD From prices (From$, From US$, or FromUSD), combined ratings, unique 674x446 heroes, and commercially diverse categories (private Ubud/east/north days, Nusa Penida land, ATV, water temples, cycling, cooking, snorkeling, rafting). The live catalog supports far more than 20 tours, including additional Nusa Penida boats, Uluwatu Kecak, Instagram circuits, waterfall SKUs, ATV+rafting combos, and Batur sunrise treks, but Viator DataDome blocking plus geo-currency dumps (EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD/BRL/CHF/SGD/IDR/A$) blocked many otherwise-strong pages from being verified in USD on a complete product page. No live helicopter tour, stargazing, or Indigenous-only cultural page with combined USD+rating+hero was captured. Did not force audio/self-guided/app tours, inactive products, thin-review SKUs, near-duplicates, private-driver-only, ticket-only, Java-only, or products with unusable heroes. Same completeness constraint documented on Bangkok (10), Kyoto (14), Tokyo (11), Lima (9), Cabo San Lucas (14), Puerto Vallarta (10), Cancun (13), and Mexico City (11).
